name: Industry intelligence
blurb: Signals, patterns and insights about an industry, linked to the products and technologies they concern, with hybrid search over the sources.
about: The industry intelligence graph tracks an industry as signals, patterns and insights, linked to the products and technologies they concern. A new signal either supports a pattern or contradicts it, so an analyst or a research agent can see which beliefs new evidence has weakened. Hybrid search over the source text is optional. The sample data covers the AI infrastructure market, from public sources.
sample: The AI infrastructure market, from public sources
